title: Cheesy One-Pot Gnocchi with Veggie Ground & Spinach

steps.text: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes.
When the onion is soft, add veggie ground to the pot and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until crumbly and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate mozzarella; finely grate Parmesan.

When the veggie ground is done, add gnocchi, tomatoes, water, Italian seasoning, and salt to the pot. Stir to combine, cover, and cook until the gnocchi is warmed through, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the gnocchi is cooking, wash and dry the spinach (skip this step if the spinach came pre-washed).
Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful; stir to combine and remove from heat.
Sprinkle both cheeses over the gnocchi and cover. Let sit until cheese is melted, 3-5 minutes.
To serve, divide gnocchi between bowls and enjoy!
